-- src/finally.js --
// The getting-started tutorial: unsubscribe and detach when the dialog closes.
require(['baja!', 'dialogs'], function (baja, dialogs) {
  var sub = new baja.Subscriber();
  dialogs.showOk(function () {
    baja.Ord.make('station:|slot:/Ramp').get({ subscriber: sub });
  })
  .promise()
  .finally(function () {
    sub.unsubscribeAll();
    sub.detach();
  });
});
-- src/hook.js --
define(['baja!', 'bajaux/Widget'], function (baja, Widget) {
  function Live() { Widget.apply(this, arguments); }
  Live.prototype.doInitialize = function () {
    this.$sub = new baja.Subscriber();
    return this.$sub.subscribe(this.value());
  };
  Live.prototype.doDestroy = function () {
    return this.$sub.unsubscribeAll();
  };
  return Live;
});
-- src/one.js --
var s = new baja.Subscriber();
function stop(comp) { return s.unsubscribe(comp); }
